verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents strong hardware media-engine capabilities for this GPU: enhanced AV1/HEVC(H.265) encode and decode support, 4:2:2 encode/decode hardware, and ~3x throughput AV1 encoding via NVENC/NVDEC (docs-9, docs-16, docs-24, docs-25, docs-27), directly serving creator livestreaming/editing workflows. However, explicit ISV/professional-app certification claims (e.g., named certifications with Adobe, Autodesk, etc.) are not present in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit ISV-certified driver/application certification list, independent benchmark corroboration of encoder claims.
